verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents custom pricing plans and several usage-based pricing models, and community evidence confirms per-user, per-usage, and per-tier subscription models. Subscriptions can be created in the Dashboard, but nothing shows the specific models, credits, commitments, or overage being configurable without code. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of graduated vs volume tiering, hybrid subscription-plus-usage configuration, credits/prepaid balances, minimum commitments, overage handling, and no-code setup of these pricing models.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code

citations.quote: you can set up and integrate different types of usage-based pricing models with your SaaS product.
Stripe Billing supports per-user, per-usage, and per-tier subscription models in an automated recurring billing fashion
Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
